page:
Fuse is a Normal Spell of Type: Spell Projectiles. It can be used by itself but is intended to be chained with other spells for greater effect.

Description: The cornerstone for developing complex spells, don't be fooled by the innocent appearance, one never knows what kind of spells this rune will unlock.

Notes:
The actual effect of this spell: This must be loaded to the left of an attack spell. Instead of firing the attack spell from a wand as normal, the spell gets loaded into a rune which is then shot forward like a long-range bullet. When the rune strikes something or reaches its range limit, the rune triggers and fires the loaded spell at that point at a slight MP cost discount.

While this would be quite useless for most spells that are already a long-range projectile or a summon, one particularly noteworthy exception would be Arcane Explosion; this transforms the short-range radial shockwave around your character into a long-range artillery cannon, and can end up MORE efficient with its MP cost if you have a lot of modifiers or a higher level Arcane Explosion with a large cost per shot so the 10% discount ends up being larger than the 1 MP additional cost of using the Rune. 

Other powerful but short-range spells could also benefit from such a setup.

page:
The Autonomous Grimoire is a Rare Spell of Type: Spell Summon. When the default spell is cast, it summons a floating book that casts the spell in the wand to the right.

The Grimoire can cast either projectile spells or summon creatures.

* If it is used to cast projectile spells, the Grimoire will automatically shoot at the nearest enemy in range.
* If it is used to cast summons, it will begin summoning creatures. If the Grimoire dies, all summons it controlled die as well. If a Grimoire summons after reaching the summoning limit, one of the existing summons will be killed and a new one is spawned near the player. This may be useful with some builds but generally hurts DPS because the summon already in combat disappears and the newly created summon has to move into place to begin combat with enemies. This can be prevented by enabling a setting in Settings > Gameplay > Summon Limit > On. With this setting on, the Grimoire will summon until the limit is hit and then stop, only summoning a new creature if an existing creature dies.

page:
Duet is a Normal Spell of Type: Spell Boost. The right spell becomes more powerful based on the damage of the left spell.

Even though the spell description does not mention it, the damage bonus from Duet applies to all spells inside the payload of duet, except those separated by another Trigger spell. 

Example 1:

Wand with simultaneous casting 1

Meteor + Duet + Volley + Magic Bullet + Laser

The duet damage bonus will apply to both the magic bullet and the laser. 

Example 2:

Wand with simultaneous casting 2

Meteor + Duet + Magic Bullet + Dazzling Fireworks + Laser + Butterfly + Rainbow

The duet damage bonus is applied to the magic bullet and rainbow but not to laser and butterfly, because those are inside of trigger spell payload.

DPS spells and Duet: When applying the duet damage to spells that do damage over time (those that have "DPS" in brackets) the Duet damage bonus is added to the overall damage per second. This means you will be hitting the enemy for dps divided by the Tick rate of the spell for each tick. 

Exception to this rule is Skull of the Cthulhu which gains x1.75 Duet damage on all its ticks.

Lightning dash does damage multiple times but does not have a DPS tag, so it benefits normally from the duet damage boost.

page:
Area Boost is a Rare Spell of Type: Spell Passive. It effectively is a rather advanced variant of the Mimicry Cube.

 takes up 4 slots to equip into a wand, then the first spell that is placed to the right of it will be duplicated into every other wand you are holding, in the leftmost position, including the "host" wand using . This will not consume a slot in those wands, the effect is created in a new, free, locked slot; correspondingly, copying a spell that needs something else to the left of it to work such as Echo or Duet is not recommended, unless you use  twice to load a triggering spell and then one of those two.

* Note, the copied spell is put to the left of any already existing locked slots on a wand, such as the Soul Set's natural Wand Spirits.
* If  is fit twice into two separate wands, the copied spell in the higher slot will go first (i.e. a copied spell set in wand 2 will take effect first before a copied spell in wand 3)

Like with Mimicry Cube, the level of  determines up to what level of the copied spell it will duplicate, and a high level  cannot create a higher level copy of a low level spell.

SPECIAL INTERACTIONS
* Magic Vine: Is never considered to have the stacking effect from empty slots to the right of it, so will always be one single iteration of the buff.
* Multi-slot spells like Arcane Barrier or Core of Flame: Do not take up their extra slots, they only show 1 single slot at the beginning of the wand but the effects are still at full strength.
* Capacity Expansion Stone: Extra slots are still added to the far right end of the wands as normal.

page:
Mana Absorption is an Epic Spell of Type: Spell Projectiles. While this spell doesn't do much damage or change with upgrades, it can provide a steady flow of mana to the wand casting it.

Description: Returns mana to you after completing its mission gratefully, but if you can cast it with less MP, what a deal

How to get free mana: Mana Absorption is not only useful for shooting itself for free; it can also be used to generate more mana than you spend, allowing you to sustain larger mana costs from other spells. The way the spell typically works is by dividing the mana returned among the amount of projectiles released. This means you can't simply put Split or Multi-Shot before it to gain free mana. Instead, you should increase the number of spells that will release Mana Absorption, or use spells that will release multiple Mana Absorptions themselves.

Here are some builds that will generate free mana:

* Arcane Nova + Mana Absorption 
* Multi-Shot + any projectile spell + any Trigger spell + Mana Absorption
* Multi-Shot + Split + Mana Absorption 
* Any projectile spell + Dazzling Fireworks + Mana Absorption
